$comment: Per-file budgets for served public assets. Measured baseline 2026-10-10 (raw/gzip bytes): islands admin-event-editor 1429/737, admin-event-text-limits 998/539, auth-status 2483/1213, avatar 287/213, copy-link 1323/714, events-calendar 5133/1991, going-count 2289/1092, member-profile 6475/2528, past-events 3350/1397, rsvp-button 14498/4201; styles 4749/1611 (esbuild 0.28.1 --minify from assets/); theme 11965/2776, event-theme 5688/1462, profile-theme 6448/1503, schedule-theme 3932/1197 (authored in public/, no assets/ source). Ceilings are measured size x1.25 rounded up (raw to 512B, gzip to 256B). Earlier history: minified baseline 2026-10-03 admin-event-editor 1429/737, admin-event-text-limits 998/539, auth-status 2081/1009, avatar 287/213, copy-link 1323/714, events-calendar 5133/1991, going-count 2289/1092, member-profile 6138/2414, past-events 3350/1397, rsvp-button 13662/4001, styles 4749/1611; baseline 2026-09-30 events-calendar 8108/2793, going-count 2776/1145, member-profile 5193/1977, past-events 3778/1434, styles 2087/882. Every JavaScript file under public/islands at any depth and every top-level public/*.css file must have a budget. Raising a ceiling requires an explicit decision explaining the growth; never relax a budget just to make CI green. assets/ holds the reviewed sources for islands and styles.css; public/ holds the deterministic build output for those (node ci/minify-assets.mjs --check fails on drift). Theme stylesheets are served as authored. Served behavior is unchanged: the binder suite executes the minified bytes.
